Measured border rows may complement independently corroborated interior rows, retaining the complete-row uniform-spacing check; no regular subset may hide contradictory or missing rows.
Keep existing contrast, coverage, spacing, one-pixel acceptance, size/component/rectangle limits and all ambiguity controls unchanged.
Missing/clipped horizontal borders, unrelated same-y evidence, touching and separated multiple panels, and volume-only layouts must continue to abstain.
